verdict.rationale: ELSTER says any ELSTER-supporting tax software can transmit through its rail (elster-docs-2, elster-supp-2), and its certificate lets returns be sent electronically without a signature (elster-docs-7, elster-supp-1), which implies programmatic, non-UI submission is possible. Beyond that, the first-party evidence centers on interactive portal and app flows, and the only probe of the developer channel (ERiC artifact host) timed out on a single keyless GET (elster-probe-1). That probe suggests the channel is hard to reach rather than proving automation is broken. missing for 10: documented API/SDK for headless use, CI or non-interactive auth guidance, accessible developer artifacts, hands-on confirmation of an automated submission.
